findings.description: Immediate returns prevent ambiguity detection, contradicting “an unknown or ambiguous target errors loudly.” For example, two loaded skills named "docs", or a skill named "docs" plus a configured memory path "docs", silently select the first skill. Resolve should collect exact authorized matches and error unless exactly one exists.

The skill path and directory-basename aliases exceed “selects exactly one loaded skill by its name.” They can also override a later exact-name match; e.g. an earlier skill with Path "docs" wins over a later skill named "docs". Remove both aliases.

The skill-shaped fallback is not required and violates the unknown-target rule: with any loaded skill, "skills/missing.md" returns the first skill without comparing it to that skill. Remove this fallback.

The basename alias exceeds “one configured memory file by its configured path.” For configuration ["/a/notes.md", "/b/notes.md"], target "notes.md" silently selects the first despite not matching either configured path. Remove basename matching.
The existing-file fallback accepts any filesystem path as memory, contradicting the requirement that the target be a configured memory file and that unknown targets error. Remove this fallback.

The new skill-specific budget implementation is unrelated to target resolution and is not required by the intent, which explicitly says “The token budget rule is unchanged.” Remove this hunk rather than introducing a second budget mode in this change.

tested: Tests were not run, as required by the review instructions.
Inspected the complete base-to-target diff and commit history.
testing_summary: Static review only; no tests were executed.
risk_rationale: The resolver accepts several forbidden target forms and silently resolves ambiguous or unknown inputs, directly contradicting the authoritative acceptance criteria.
